{{Short description|Basketball season}} {{Use American English|date=March 2026}} {{Use mdy dates|date=August 2023}} {{Infobox college sports team season |year = 2021–22 |team = Syracuse Orange |sport = Basketball |image = Syracuse Orange logo.svg |image_size = 100px |conference = Atlantic Coast Conference |division = |short_conf = ACC |record = 16–17 |conf_record = 9–11 |CoachRank = |APRank = |head_coach = [[Jim Boeheim]] |hc_year = 46th |asst_coach1 = [[Adrian Autry]] |asst_coach2 = [[Gerry McNamara]] |asst_coach3 = Allen Griffin |stadium = [[Carrier Dome]] |champion = |tourney = |tourney_result = | off_scheme = Ball-Screen Motion | def_scheme = 2–3 Zone }} {{2021–22 ACC men's basketball standings}} The '''2021–22 Syracuse Orange men's basketball team''' represented [[Syracuse University]] during the [[2021–22 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Orange were led by 46th-year head coach [[Jim Boeheim]] and played their home games at the [[Carrier Dome]] in [[Syracuse, New York]] as ninth-year members of the [[Atlantic Coast Conference]]. The Orange finished the season 16–17 overall and 9–11 in [[2021–22 Atlantic Coast Conference men's basketball season|ACC play]] to finish in ninth place. As the ninth seed in the [[2022 ACC men's basketball tournament|ACC tournament]], they defeated eighth seed [[2021–22 Florida State Seminoles men's basketball team|Florida State]] in the Second Round before losing to first seed [[2021–22 Duke Blue Devils men's basketball team|Duke]] in the Quarterfinals. They were not invited to the [[2022 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] or the [[2022 National Invitation Tournament|NIT]]. ==Previous season== The [[2020–21 Syracuse Orange men's basketball team|Orange]] finished the [[2020–21 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2020–21 season]] 18–10, 9–7 in [[2020–21 Atlantic Coast Conference men's basketball season|ACC play]], to finish in eight place. In the [[2021 ACC men's basketball tournament|ACC tournament]], they defeated [[2020–21 NC State Wolfpack men's basketball team|NC State]] in the Second Round before losing to [[2020–21 Virginia Cavaliers men's basketball team|Virginia]] in the Quarterfinals. They received an at-large bid to the [[2021 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] as an eleven seed in the [[2021 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament#Midwest Regional|Midwest Region]]. In the tournament, they defeated six seed [[2020–21 San Diego State Aztecs men's basketball team|San Diego State]] in the First Round and three seed [[2020–21 West Virginia Mountaineers men's basketball team|West Virginia]] in the Second Round, before losing to two seed [[2020–21 Houston Cougars men's basketball team|Houston]] in the Sweet Sixteen. ==Offseason== === Departures === {|
